name: janitor
description: Behavior-preserving codebase care: cleaner (dead-code removal, file splitting, deduplication) and manager (structural file and directory refactor) without public API changes.

interface.longDescription: Cleaner removes dead code, splits oversized files, and merges duplicates; manager restructures files and directories, all while keeping behavior and public APIs stable.
defaultPrompt: Use Janitor to clean up this codebase without changing behavior.
Find dead code, duplicate logic, and oversized files.
Refactor this code while keeping the public API stable.
Restructure oversized files and regroup directories without changing behavior.
